name: Urban Wildlife Alliance
region_note: FOUND BY A REVIEWER - organizations from the Mayor's Alliance lists whose sites turn automated checks away, or had moved; supplied and confirmed by a reviewer 2026-11-03
notes: The Mayor's Alliance points people here when they have found an injured bird and cannot pick it up or have no way to transport it: email the helpline and an automatic reply arrives straight away with instructions. For a bird you can carry, the Wild Bird Fund is the first call. Do not give a wild animal food or water while waiting. A reviewer confirmed this on the organization's own site on 2026-11-03. The site shows automated checks a bot test, so the weekly check cannot read it and a person re-confirms it instead.
type_raw: Volunteer wildlife helpline and referral (email) for people trying to help an injured bird or other wild animal
